name: What interior remodeling projects offer the best return on investment (ROI)?

mainEntity.name: What interior remodeling projects offer the best return on investment (ROI)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen and bathroom remodels often offer the highest return on investment, as these areas are key selling points for any home. Minor updates like fresh paint, new flooring, and updated fixtures can also significantly improve perceived value without a major overhaul. The specific ROI can depend on the local real estate market in areas like Garden City or Star. When planning, consider a balance between personal enjoyment and potential resale value, prioritizing functional improvements that enhance daily living while appealing to a broad range of future buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom remodels typically offer the best ROI. Minor updates like paint and flooring also improve value.
